A person bust fills a cleared lower-right corner of an office building. The placement supports either a user badge modifying the building or a natural person-in-front-of-office scene.

## Visual draft

A rectangular office building with four square windows is interrupted at its lower right by a person bust. The circular head and rounded shoulders occupy the cleared corner.

## Open question

Does the person act as an account or occupancy badge, or belong to a natural office scene?

## 1. Four window office building (solo)

A tall rounded rectangular office building faces forward with four square windows arranged in two rows. Exclude the person bust from the lower-right corner; the building remains the independent subject.

## 2. Person bust (sub)

A circular head sits above rounded shoulders with short vertical arm divisions. Exclude the office building; isolate the plain person bust visible at the lower right.
